# KaTeX 0.16.22

Unmodified browser assets from the official npm package, served locally to keep math rendering independent of CDN availability. Includes every font referenced by katex.min.css and the upstream MIT license.

Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.16.22.tgz

Verified npm archive integrity: `sha512-XCHRdUw4lf3SKBaJe4EvgqIuWwkPSo9XoeO8GjQW94Bp7TWv9hNhzZjZ+OH9yf1UmLygb7DIT5GSFQiyt16zYg==`

The CSS, core JavaScript and auto-render SHA384 hashes match the previously deployed SRI attributes. SHA256SUMS lists all shipped upstream files. No package install or network request is required during Hugo builds.

To update, verify the new official archive integrity, replace these assets and hashes, update the feature partial and resource hint URLs/SRI together, then run renderer and browser checks with KaTeX CDN requests blocked.
